purpose: Shared Anthropic price table (operator decision A, 2026-10-14). Prices transcribed from Anthropic's official pricing page only; no third-party source. Same schema as results/cloud_prices_20261008.json (models -> tier -> short/long -> input, cached_input, cache_write, output, USD per 1M tokens) so analysis/cloud_budget_forecast.py call_cost and session_cost read it unchanged. cached_input = the page's 'Cache hits and refreshes' column; cache_write = the page's '5m cache writes' column; cache_write_1h = the '1h cache writes' column (not used by call_cost).
source_note: docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing answered 301 Moved Permanently to platform.claude.com/docs/en/docs/about-claude/pricing (Anthropic's own docs domain); the redirect target was fetched and its page header gives the canonical URL above. https://www.anthropic.com/pricing was not needed. Model IDs from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview; minimum cacheable prompt lengths and the 5-minute default lifetime from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching (both Anthropic's own docs, fetched the same session).
fetch_method: WebFetch (page converted to text and read back); prices transcribed from that text
context_tiers: Quoted: 'Claude 4.6 and later models (except Claude Haiku 5.5) ... include the full 1M token context window at standard pricing.' 'Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices.' So short = long for every model except claude-haiku-5-5, whose long tier applies above long_context_above = 100000 prompt tokens.

caching_rules_quoted.multipliers: 5-minute cache write: 1.25x base input price (Cache valid for 5 minutes). 1-hour cache write: 2x base input price. Cache read (hit): 0.1x base input price (0.025x on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1; 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5).
caching_rules_quoted.sonnet_5_5_hit: On Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5, a cache hit costs 5% of the standard input price ($0.20 USD per million tokens on Claude Opus 5.5, $0.10 USD on Claude Sonnet 5.5).
caching_rules_quoted.automatic_caching: Automatic caching: Add a single cache_control field at the top level of your request. The system automatically manages cache breakpoints as conversations grow. (pricing page); 'The system automatically applies the cache breakpoint to the last cacheable block and moves it forward as conversations grow.' (prompt-caching page)
caching_rules_quoted.lifetime: By default, the cache has a 5-minute lifetime. The cache is refreshed for no additional cost each time the cached content is used. (prompt-caching page)
caching_rules_quoted.minimum_cacheable_prefix: 512 tokens for Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, and Claude Haiku 5.5; 1,024 tokens for Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, ...; 4,096 tokens for Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.5; 4,096 tokens for Claude Haiku 4.5 (prompt-caching page)
caching_rules_quoted.tokenizer: Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview use a newer tokenizer ... This tokenizer produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text. (pricing page). Token counts in this repo are o200k_base or the harness's local estimate, not Anthropic's tokenizer: the token basis is an assumption wherever this table is used.

selection.why: The models overview lists four current models: Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5. Sonnet 5.5 is described there as 'The best combination of speed and intelligence' and is the middle price tier (2 / 10 USD per MTok), the same role gpt-6.1-sol had in results/cloud_prices_20261008.json.

claude-sonnet-5.page_note_quoted: The $2/$10 per million input/output token pricing for Claude Sonnet 5, announced at launch as introductory pricing through August 31, 2026, is now the standard price.

model_ids_note: IDs for the four current models are the 'Claude API ID' row of the models overview (claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5). The four legacy rows are keyed by the same dateless pattern for lookup only; their API IDs were not transcribed from the overview (it links them, it does not list their IDs) and must be checked before any live call.
not_used: Batch cache rates are not listed on the page as numbers (it says the caching multipliers stack with the Batch discount); batch rows carry input and output only. Data-residency (1.1x) and fast-mode prices are not used.
